_comment: General payment method guidance for Southeast University (SEU) students. Official payment details must be confirmed with the SEU Accounts Office.
disclaimer: Official payment details must be confirmed with the SEU Accounts Office.

methods.name: Bank Deposit
methods.accountValue: Not available yet — confirm designated bank branch and account number with the SEU Accounts Office
methods.referenceFormat: Use your Student ID and Semester Code (confirm with the SEU Accounts Office)
steps: Collect the tuition fee deposit slip from the designated bank branch or the SEU Accounts Office.
Write your full name, Student ID, Department, Batch, Semester, and the installment amount you are paying.
Deposit the amount at the bank counter and make sure the officer stamps and signs both the bank copy and the student copy.
Keep the stamped student copy safely and submit or show a copy to the SEU Accounts Office if required.
notes: Official payment details must be confirmed with the SEU Accounts Office.
Double-check your Student ID on the deposit slip before leaving the bank counter.
Keep a clear photo or scan of the stamped bank receipt for your personal records.

methods.name: bKash
methods.accountValue: Not available yet — confirm official bKash Biller ID or UMS payment gateway link with the SEU Accounts Office
methods.referenceFormat: Use your Student ID as the Reference / Bill Number
steps: Check your SEU UMS portal or contact the SEU Accounts Office for the active bKash Education Fee biller or online gateway option.
Select the authorized Southeast University biller option and enter your Student ID and billing semester.
Verify your name, Student ID, and installment amount before entering your PIN.
Complete the payment and save the confirmation SMS and digital receipt.
Record your bKash Transaction ID (TrxID) and payment date in the Payment Tracker on this page.
notes: Official payment details must be confirmed with the SEU Accounts Office.
Never share your bKash PIN or OTP with anyone.
Keep the bKash TrxID and digital receipt until the payment reflects in your student ledger.

methods.name: Nagad
methods.accountValue: Not available yet — confirm official Nagad biller code or UMS gateway option with the SEU Accounts Office
methods.referenceFormat: Use your Student ID as the Reference / Bill Number
steps: Confirm the active Nagad biller or online payment gateway option with the SEU Accounts Office or your UMS portal.
Enter your Student ID, semester code, and the exact installment amount.
Review the student reference details on the confirmation screen and complete the transaction.
Save the Nagad Transaction ID (TrxID) in the Payment Tracker above and keep a screenshot of the receipt.
notes: Official payment details must be confirmed with the SEU Accounts Office.
Check whether any gateway convenience charge applies before confirming the payment.
Retain the Nagad TrxID until your student ledger is updated.

methods.name: Rocket (DBBL)
methods.accountValue: Not available yet — confirm official Rocket Biller ID with the SEU Accounts Office
methods.referenceFormat: Use your Student ID as the Bill / Reference Number
steps: Verify the official SEU Rocket Biller ID with the SEU Accounts Office before initiating a transfer.
Open the Rocket app or USSD menu, select Bill Pay, and enter your Student ID and installment amount.
Verify all details carefully and confirm the transaction.
Save the Transaction ID from the confirmation SMS in your Payment Tracker.
notes: Official payment details must be confirmed with the SEU Accounts Office.
Keep the confirmation SMS and submit proof of payment to the Accounts Office if requested.

methods.name: Cash / Booth at Accounts Office
methods.accountValue: Authorized Bank Booth inside the SEU Campus (Sunday to Thursday, 10:00 AM – 3:30 PM; confirm current hours with the SEU Accounts Office)
methods.referenceFormat: Bring your Student ID Card and Registration / Advising Slip
steps: Visit the authorized bank collection booth inside the Southeast University campus during official operating hours.
Present your Student ID card and state which installment (1st, 2nd, or 3rd) you are paying.
Pay the amount at the counter and collect the printed official money receipt.
Check that your Student ID, name, and paid amount are printed accurately on the receipt before leaving.
notes: Official payment details must be confirmed with the SEU Accounts Office.
Pay only at the authorized campus counter/booth and always keep the printed receipt.
